6.187 rsMissingDataGrouping
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsMissingDataGrouping is a critical error that will occur when a CustomReportItem contains
DataRow.DataCell elements but does not contain corresponding DataRowGroupings.DataGroupings
elements.
